svg.text: GHOSTED: Brett Bullet-Points body map v1 (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Decided before the sheet: proportions in head-heights, landmarks, attachment points (halo, collar, thumb, fingers), and a check at the game camera (26 m, pitch 42).
A. FRONT (upright, symmetric)
halo centre (floats) y 0
top of swoop y 16
top of hair cap y 32
hairline (centre) y 62
eye line = ear points y 94
mouth (grin) y 114
chin y 144
neck line = shirt collar y 152
shoulder joint (arm root) y 176
chest (widest) y 188
vest V point y 198
vest hem = waist y 252
knee y 298
sole y 340
1 head
B. SIDE (same lines)
C. HANDS: the thumb and the fingers (front, x2.2)
Ball hand; thumb and fingers are small capsules from the top of the ball.
LIKE: thumb up
bullet 1
bullet 3
PROPORTIONS (head = top of swoop to chin = 128 units)
Whole figure 324 units = 2.53 heads (Kit 2.71, Ricky 2.67,
Dot 2.27): the tallest of the humans, a peer.
Size: 1.05 x Kit on screen = 78.75 px (figure, no halo);
estimate 1.23 m to the swoop top (1 u = 3.81 mm),
1.32 m to the halo top.
Head 108 wide (skull 98 tall); hair cap 118 wide.
Body: a WEDGE. 32 wide at the neck, 148 at the chest
(y 188), 72 at the waist (y 252); chinos 40 wide each.
LANDMARKS
Hairline: high and clean, y 62 centre, y 84-88 at the
temples; side part on his right (viewer-left).
Swoop: one rolled wave from the part, up and over
to his left; its lowest point y 57 at x 120, above the hairline.
Eye line y 94; eyes x 132 / 168 (ink ovals + glint).
Ears: on the eye line at the head sides (x 95 / 205).
Mouth zone x 120-180, y 102-126: a wide grin = white teeth
(row 23) over an ink smile line, corners up. Not a bar.
Neck: chin y 144, shirt collar at the neck line y 152.
Shoulder joint: x 92 / 208, y 176 (X +-56 inside the
vest). Shirt sleeve out of the armhole, then the hand.
ATTACHMENT POINTS (magenta)
Halo: level ring, centre on the head axis, y 0 (16
above the swoop top). Ring 76 x 60 across, tube 12.
Follows the head (position, roll); stays LEVEL under a nod.
Collar: open shirt collar on the neck line, the vest
V from the collar to y 198. No tie (Kit, Ricky have one).
Thumb / fingers: on the top of the hand ball.
CARRIAGE (in game): chin up 10 deg about the chin
Smug, and it turns the grin to the camera: at 1x the
grin reads as teeth only with it (see E). The model
sheet turnaround stays neutral for the build.
E. GAME CAMERA CHECK (x3, 1x at right). Left: Brett estimate. Middle: landmark dots (blue: eyes, mouth, hairline, ears, V, hands, hem, feet;
magenta: halo centre, collar). Right: Kit, real v7 render. Net yaw 5 (lineup facing), pitch 42.
Hair vs eyes at 1x: lowest hair in the eye columns is 5.7 px (left) and 6.2 px (right) ABOVE the eye top. The swoop alone: 8.1 / 10.9 px above.
Grin at 1x: 14.9 x 4.3 px, starting 0.1 px under the eyes. Teeth (row 23) over an ink smile line with the corners up: reads as a grin, not a beard (dark or white).
Halo centre 29.5 px above the eyes; the ring shows as an open ellipse over the hair (pitch 42), green with the ink edge.
Height: 80 px without the halo (target 78.75), 92 px with it. Kit is 75 px.
Read: a green ring over a blond swoop, a peach face with two dots and a white grin, a red wedge
with a white V and white sleeves, navy legs. Nothing green on the body.
